name: chart
summary: A bar or line chart drawn with HTML and CSS on the server, with the numbers as a table for screen readers. The first series takes the accent color and the others are greys, so the series to look at stands out; palette="multi" gives each series its own color. Hovering a column shows its values (CSS only). Values start at zero.
use: A few series over a short range of labels: months, weeks, categories

avoid.case: Exact values people compare or copy

parts.description: The chart (<figure>): its title, a legend, the plot and a visually hidden table of the same numbers.

title.description: Required. Says what is measured and in what unit, e.g. "月ごとの売上（万円）".

labels.description: The labels along the bottom, one per value.

series.description: Up to 5 series; each has one value per label. The first is the one to look at.
series.x-ts-type: readonly { name: string; values: readonly number[] }[]

unit.description: Written after each value in the tooltip and the table, e.g. "万円".

hideTitle.description: Hide the title visually (it still names the figure and the table), for a chart under a heading that already says it.

height.description: Height of the plot in px.

palette.description: quiet: accent and greys. multi: a color per series.

rules: title is required; it names the figure and the table.
The plot is hidden from assistive technology; the table carries the numbers.
Do not tell series apart by color alone in the text around the chart; name them.

examples.title: Monthly sales
examples.code: <Chart title="月ごとの売上（万円）" unit="万円" labels={["6月", "7月", "8月"]} series={[{ name: "今年", values: [42, 51, 47] }, { name: "去年", values: [38, 40, 45] }]} />
